persona.name: Arjun Mehta
persona.about: You are Arjun, 29, a backend engineer at Tidepool, a 12-person startup in Bengaluru that builds a payments reconciliation API. You also maintain a small open source cron library called quickcron. Your manager is Neha Kapoor, teammates are Rohan Iyer (backend), Fatima Sheikh (frontend) and Wei Chen (staff engineer), plus Diego Alvarez, a contractor in Madrid. Your sister Kavya's wedding is next weekend in Jaipur.
persona.style: Precise, terse, developer shorthand (PR, CI, lgtm, nit). Lowercase, no greetings. Pastes PR numbers like #214. Dislikes fluff and being asked things he already said.
persona.aboutMe: Backend at Tidepool. GitHub: arjunm. Prefer Slack for team stuff, email only for external.

issues.title: Webhook retries double-post settlements when Razorpay times out
issues.body: When the Razorpay webhook times out after 10s we retry, but the first request still commits. Seen 3 times last week for merchant m_7741. Need an idempotency key on settlement inserts.
issues.author: neha-k

issues.title: Add CSV export for reconciliation report
issues.body: Finance teams want a CSV of the daily report with matched/unmatched counts.
issues.author: fatima-s

issues.title: Flaky: settlement_sync spec times out on CI
issues.body: settlement_sync.spec.ts times out roughly 1 in 6 runs on CI, never locally. Probably the Postgres container cold start.
issues.author: arjunm

issues.title: Rate limit /v2/match per API key
issues.body: One merchant is sending 400 rps during month-end. Need per-key token bucket.
issues.author: neha-k

issues.title: Docs: wrong example for /v2/settlements pagination
issues.body: cursor param is called after, not cursor.
issues.author: diego-alv

pulls.title: Idempotency key on settlement inserts (fixes #198)
pulls.body:
Adds settlement_idempotency table, unique on (merchant_id, provider_ref). Retries now no-op.

Migration: 0042_settlement_idempotency.sql
pulls.author: rohan-iyer

pulls.title: CSV export for daily reconciliation report
pulls.body: Implements #203. New endpoint GET /v2/reports/daily.csv streaming rows with matched/unmatched counts. Adds report_exports table for audit.

issues.title: DST transition skips 02:30 jobs in Europe/London
issues.body: On the March DST change a job at 30 2 * * * never runs. Expected: run at 03:30 or document it.
issues.author: hannah-lowe

issues.title: Support L (last day of month)
issues.body: Would love 0 9 L * * for month-end jobs.
